//: Config-MERGE overlay that adds Windows Authenticode signing. Applied via `--config src-tauri/tauri.windows-sign.conf.json` by the release workflow ONLY when Azure Trusted Signing creds are present. Kept OUT of the base config so ordinary/unsigned builds never invoke signCommand (which previously broke the Windows build with 'failed to run pwsh' + a SignTool error on the sidecar). No signCommand in the base = no signing attempt unless this overlay is explicitly merged in.
